title: When things go wrong
summary: Lost phone, card problems, asking for help

sentences.pt: O meu cartão não está a funcionar.

passages.text: Para bloquear la tarjeta tiene que llamar a su banco, el número está en la aplicación. Y para el móvil, lo mejor es poner una denuncia en la comisaría; la más cercana está en esta misma calle, al fondo.
passages.en: To block the card you have to call your bank, the number is in the app. And for the phone, it's best to report it at the police station; the nearest one is at the end of this same street.
passages.question: What two things should you do?
passages.answer: Call your bank to block the card, and report the phone at the police station down this street.
wrong: Visit a bank branch, then buy a new phone.
Call the police about the card, and wait for the phone.
Go back to your hotel and wait for a call.

passages.text: Para cancelar o cartão tem de ligar para o seu banco, o número está na aplicação. Quanto ao telemóvel, o melhor é fazer queixa na esquadra; a mais próxima fica nesta mesma rua, lá ao fundo.
passages.en: To cancel the card you have to call your bank, the number is in the app. As for the phone, it's best to report it at the police station; the nearest one is at the far end of this same street.
passages.question: What two things should you do?
passages.answer: Call your bank to cancel the card, and report the phone at the police station down this street.
wrong: Visit a bank branch, then buy a new phone.
Call the police about the card, and wait for the phone.
Go back to your hotel and wait for a call.
